_comment: Copy this file to the location ROSTER_PATH points at, or to roster.json inside
your transcripts directory (the default). Real rosters are never committed —
roster.json is gitignored, and the default location is outside this repo.
List everyone on the calendar invite, not only whoever was visibly present:
a speaker who is missing from the roster gets named 'unknown' rather than
'aliases' is where the value is. Put every form a person is called out loud —
nicknames, diminutives, and the spellings your transcription tends to produce.
Two people sharing an alias is expected and handled: enrichment caps its
confidence on any name that rests on a shared form.
